text:
maya: quick post from tonight's noisy handoff run: small fraction of enqueue entries never resolve after a release + retry race. memory slowly climbs and we get token tail spikes. short trace below.

otto: paste the tiny snippet pls

maya:
```
[lease] release prefix=team/sol epoch=721 -> OK
[evict] enqueue id=0x7ff prefix=team/sol owner=old -> ENQUEUED
[lease] release retry prefix=team/sol epoch=721 -> OK (retry)
[evict] enqueue id=0x7ff prefix=team/sol -> dedupe: present (no ack)
[new-owner] bind shard -> ok
[evict] dequeue id=0x7ff -> index-miss (owner-key mismatch)
```

reza: yeah that's the ack-window leak we talked about. two quick mitigations: a) bounded wait on release RPC for enqueue ack (200ms) then emit fallback metric; b) low-rate background reaper that remaps or prunes unreachable entries.

nina: both make sense. wait helps most races but increases release latency; reaper is eventual and safe if rate-limited. We should also consider a longer-term switch to owner-agnostic enqueue keys (global enqueue-id) with CAS-based dedupe.

ciara: couple of gotchas: tombstones must still be able to delete entries regardless of epoch, but we must prevent old tombstones from removing fresh entries. proposal: tombstone includes tombstone_epoch and we only apply if tombstone_epoch >= enqueue_origin_epoch.

maya: for short-term plan I'm going to: flip on release-wait=200ms behind a feature flag on a single canary node, add reaper at 0.5% qps that only touches prefixes with >2 handoffs in 30s, and emit metrics: release_wait_fallback, orphaned_queue_entries, reaper_actions.

otto: ops checklist: dashboards for those metrics, smoke test (handoff storm + delayed retries), rollback (disable wait flag + accelerate reaper TTL). postmortem if orphaned_queue_entries > 500 for 10m.

reza: long-term RFC should compare three models: stable enqueue-id + index CAS, small handoff ledger mapping enqueue-id->owner, or improved fencing (epoch on enqueue + dequeue gating). include migration plan, index cost, CAS perf benchmarks, and tombstone semantics.

ciara: add tests: chaotic retries, tombstone racing, and canary that simulates network partitions. also add audit logs for any reaper deletes and require operator confirmation if >100 deletes in 5m.

maya: will open a PR with the canary patch + smoke tests. tagging reviewers. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary roll started: ack-window-mitigate.v1 -> canary-2 at 2026-03-23T23:55:00Z

ciara: one small extra: when we implement release-wait, make the wait non-blocking (use async wait with timeout) so thread pools don't get exhausted under load. keep a hard cap of 500 concurrent waits per node.

maya: good catch, will implement that. thanks all.
